title: USF Interface Contract Schema
description: Draft JSON Schema for interface contracts (API routes, commands, queries, event handlers, service boundaries, CLI interfaces, provider ports, adapter interfaces, internal/external contracts). Each declares its kind (interface-kinds), purpose, boundary, a reference to the governing semantic contract, and at least one input/output (request/response) contract. Interfaces are contract-first or contract-reconciled and MUST NOT be inferred from handlers when a contract exists. USF claims no full OpenAPI compliance until concrete OpenAPI artefacts exist. Governs the ontology concepts Interface, Service, and Port. The four contract-body objects are deliberately-open extension points: their internal shape is a deferred per-interface contract body, so they are typed as object with a documented rationale rather than accidentally open. GOVERNANCE ENVELOPE: instances MUST carry id, title, description, authorityLevel, lifecycleState, ontologyConcepts, taxonomyRefs, vocabularyRefs, and aiGuidance (schema-authoring-standard section 9/11); kind (artefact-kinds) and version are deviated/deferred (recorded per section 9.3). lifecycleState draft; not active.

contractBody.$comment: Deliberately-open extension point: the per-interface request/response contract body; internal shape deferred to interface-contract import.

authorityLevel.$comment: authority-levels value pinned to the registry authorityRole.

anyOf.$comment: At least one input/output (request/response) contract must be present, matching the description.
